37829.question_text: The relative atomic mass of chlorine is not a whole number because
37829.explanation: The relative atomic mass of an element is calculated as a weighted average of the masses of its naturally occurring isotopes. Because the isotopes of chlorine (\(^{35}\)Cl and \(^{37}\)Cl) occur in different proportions (natural abundance), their masses are averaged according to those percentages. The resulting value (approximately 35.5) is not a whole number because it reflects this proportional distribution rather than the mass of a single atom.

it is the average mass of all the isotopes of the element
the element has strong oxidizing ability
the atom contains a higher number of neutrons than protons

Imole Q occupies 22400 cm3
x mole occupies 800 cm3
x = \(\frac{800 x 1}{22400}\)
= 0.036mol

Molar mass = Mass ÷ Mole 

                    = 1 ÷ 0.036

 Molar mass ≈ 28 g/mol

37859.subject: Chemistry
37859.question_text: Which of the following factors would affect the equilibrium constant?
37859.explanation: Equilibrium constants aren't changed if you change the concentrations of things present in the equilibrium. The only thing that changes an equilibrium constant is a change of temperature. Yes, temperature is the only factor that affects the value of an equilibrium constant; changes in concentration or pressure do not change the equilibrium constant, only the position of the equilibrium itself, as explained by Le Chatelier's principle.
